name: indicators
description: Standalone position selection for a finite flow. Pagination does not own the flow content.

name: numbered-pages
description: Visible page labels with a zero-based accepted index, suitable for composing with result pages.

name: dialog-stages
description: Labeled stages can share the same control; the dialog retains presence and validation policy.

name: unavailable
description: The content owner can disable selection while a page is unavailable.
